text.line.m.a1.09.flagged: Sergeant Bell on the patrol channel: the Yard's tow truck is on the hot list. All units, that is the one.
text.line.m.a1.09.hide: Fresh paint, same engine. Now get under the freeway viaduct and let the patrol lose you.
text.line.m.a1.09.home: Quiet street, clean truck. Bring it home before the sun is up.
text.line.m.a1.09.sprayed: Odessa here. Half an hour in the booth and the truck is a new color. The patrol has no plate to chase.
text.line.m.a1.09.start: Odessa here. The depot cameras caught our tow truck. Take it out of the Yard and get it to the body shop in Dogpatch before they box it in.
text.mission.m.a1.09.fail.tow: The tow truck is wrecked. Start again.
text.mission.m.a1.09.obj.escape_viaduct: Lose the patrol under the freeway viaduct
text.mission.m.a1.09.obj.goto_shop: Pull into the body shop in Dogpatch
text.mission.m.a1.09.title: Respray
